# Synthetic runner fixtures

These nine small files are synthetic inputs and receipts from engineering checks of the lock guards in the molecular runners. They are not study results and no reported value depends on them.

`chemistry_T/D/D_FINAL_WINNERS.npz` is a placeholder JSON text file with an `.npz` name, so `numpy.load` cannot read it as an archive. `INVALID_LOCK.json`, `REJECTED_T_LOCK.json` and `SYNTHETIC_BAD_LOCK.json` are deliberately unusable locks.
